fields.name: Mapper query-result handler signature family
fields.contract: ListFromReaderResultsHandler<TModel>, ModelFromOutResultsHandler<TModel,...>, ModelFromReaderResultsHandler<TModel,...> and ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler<TModel> are all named query-result handler methods, but they do not all conform to the same ArgentSea.QueryResultModelHandler<TArg, TModel> delegate shape: (TModel instance, short shardId, string sprocName, TArg optionalArgument, DbDataReader rdr, DbParameterCollection parameters, string connectionDescription, ILogger logger). ModelFromOutResultsHandler, ModelFromReaderResultsHandler and ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler each have an instance-supplied overload taking exactly that eight-parameter shape (the instance first, then the same seven-parameter tail), and only that overload can be assigned to or invoked through the delegate type. ListFromReaderResultsHandler, and the no-instance overloads of ModelFromOutResultsHandler and ModelFromReaderResultsHandler, instead take only the seven-parameter tail with no leading instance parameter; the no-instance overloads are convenience forwarders that construct a new TModel and call their instance-supplied overload, and none of these seven-parameter methods is itself assignable to QueryResultModelHandler<TArg, TModel>. ModelFromOutResultsHandler and ModelFromReaderResultsHandler each additionally overload across zero through eight TReaderResultN type parameters, one per extra data-reader result set consumed as a list and assigned to a compatible model property. ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler instead takes no TReaderResultN type parameters: it discovers how many trailing result sets to read, and in what order, at runtime from the model type's own CollectionMapAttributeBase-decorated properties.

references.label: QueryResultModelHandler<TArg,TModel> delegate declaration establishing the eight-parameter shape this block asserts assignability against
